featured.name: Switch List — Yard Switching Sim
featured.blurb: A free, open training simulator for railway conductors: read the yard, line the road, call PULL / SPOT / KICK, and win in the fewest engine moves. Every mechanic cites a Canadian Rail Operating Rule — built straight out of my own time working freight.
points: Line switches and call moves on a live yard canvas
Two scores — Moves (the goal) and Joints (couplings)
“Watch optimal” replays the fewest-moves line in slow motion
19 jobs, each machine-verified solvable at par before it ships

projects.name: The Bench — JD-PORTFOLIO REV 1
projects.tag: résumé · a circuit board you probe
projects.blurb: My second portfolio, and the cold opposite of this one: a printed circuit board where every project is a component you probe for a full datasheet — architecture, electrical characteristics, pin description, and a live readout. Built for the technical read, with a print-to-PDF spec-sheet résumé. Single file, no build.

projects.name: The Index
projects.blurb: My third portfolio, and the plainest of the three: no night sky, no circuit board, no lore — just every project I've shipped, in one filterable capability matrix. Selected work up top, the full index below, a print-to-PDF résumé, and counts that can't drift because they're tallied straight from the data. The one you hand a recruiter.

projects.name: CROR Training Assistant
projects.tag: rail reference · vanilla js, no build
projects.blurb: A reference-first study companion for railway conductors, grounded in the January 2025 Canadian Rail Operating Rules: search any rule, signal, or definition and get a fast answer with its citation and a trust flag. Then drill it — flashcards, multiple choice, and rule-number recall generated straight from the reference — and track your weak spots over time. The thing you keep open the night before.

projects.name: CROR Trainer — Grande Prairie
projects.blurb: A browser study tool for CN freight conductors on the Grande Prairie yard, grounded in the January 2025 Canadian Rail Operating Rules: rule drills, an animated switching sim and puzzle, an interactive yard board, signal reading, and a step-by-step radio walkthrough.

projects.name: Star Charter Pro
projects.blurb: Pilot a survey probe with heavy, drifty momentum, trace each constellation's blueprint on the atlas plate, and refit your instruments every third plate — dodging asteroids, black holes, and drifting space-fauna. A single-file roguelite built in this site's own night-sky style.

projects.name: Echo Bat — Night Harvest
projects.blurb: A bat in the dark, harvesting glowing fruit by sonar. Your voice paints the cave, then the dark takes it back. A mobile-first, single-file canvas game. Part of the Star Charter collection.

projects.name: Glass Atlas
projects.blurb: A generative star-atlas plate generator. Every reroll is a 1-of-1 print; the seed rides in the URL so any plate is shareable and re-rollable, and saves as a PNG. Single file, deterministic.

projects.name: Orbital Field
projects.blurb: A quiet gravity toy: drag to fling a world, hold to bend gravity, tap for an orbit. Bodies trace and decay across a dark field. No goals, no score — just orbits.

projects.name: Sentinel-Pro
projects.blurb: A read-only intelligence cockpit for ES & NQ futures. The first model is retired — its market-data feed proved unreliable, so it's being rebuilt on a source I can trust. The honesty is the point: it watches the market, never touches it, and shows nothing it can't stand behind.

projects.name: Warcraft III — The Codex
projects.blurb: Custom survival and maze maps scripted in Lua — including a browser-playable homage to Coin Survival you can run right now.

projects.name: Diablo — Act 1
projects.blurb: A single-file canvas action-RPG — a vertical slice from town through the moor and the den to Blood Raven, with three classes and D2-style safe-zone map generation.

projects.name: Spectrum
projects.blurb: The one that ate the other three. Doomfeed, Macroscope, and Richter folded into a single Rust engine: it reads a wide spread of finance, politics, tech, and world news, has a local LLM sort each headline into one band and weigh it, and posts the ones that matter as themed cards to the matching Discord channel. A small Tauri control panel rides on top — start it, stop it, watch it work. One read per headline, no dashboards, no cloud model, no API keys; a quiet channel beats a wrong card.

projects.name: Macroscope
projects.blurb: Doomfeed's market-desk sibling. It reads a wide spread of macro and market news, has a local LLM weigh each headline for likely impact — which market, which way, how big, how sure — and posts the movers as colour-coded severity cards to Discord and a light equity-research dashboard. Sentiment only: it reads the tape, never trades it, and a blank card beats a wrong one.

projects.name: Richter
projects.blurb: Macroscope's world-desk sibling. It reads a wide spread of world, political, and breaking news, has a local LLM score each headline for how big and how loud it is — arena, heat, virality, stakes, how sure — and posts the loudest as magnitude-scored cards to Discord and a broadsheet wire-desk dashboard. Newsworthiness only: it reads the room, never the truth, and a blank card beats a false alarm.

projects.name: Doomfeed
projects.blurb: A self-hosted feed of the world's worst news. It scrapes wars, shootings, and disasters, has a local LLM write a flat, factual summary — severity rated, location tagged, no cloud model and no API keys — and posts each one as a colour-coded card to a Discord channel. It does not do good news.

projects.name: The Boys' Bots
projects.blurb: Node + discord.js bots for the group server — Ask-Johnny, a deadpan Groq-powered persona bot, and Fun-Police, a tiny ban-list bot. Small, useful, self-hosted.

projects.name: Bonnie Day
projects.blurb: A multi-page concept site for a Wolseley café — menu, story, and visit pages, built mobile-first.

projects.name: Garwood Grill
projects.blurb: A one-page concept site for a Pembina Hwy diner — menu, hours, reviews, and tap-to-call, in a warm old-school style.

projects.name: Hoagie Boyz
projects.blurb: A one-page concept site for a South Osborne sub shop.

projects.name: Caddy Shed Golf
projects.blurb: A pitch for a Winnipeg golf-simulator lounge — a hub presenting three full design directions (Premium Heritage, Modern Sport, Local & Warm) plus a printable proposal. Pick a lane, then build it.
